PLAN "Postpartum Return to Movement"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary recovery:

      DAY Monday mobility 30m "Gentle movement and breathing":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 2x12 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds

          child_pose 2x30 rpe 1 rest 30 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 2x30 rpe 1 rest 30 seconds
